title: Midnight Programming
logline: Midnight Programming is a public-access show that exists only in the psychosphere, broadcasting in the middle of the night on a station you can reach only when you’re half asleep. A dreamy anthology of strange stories, it drifts through a mixed bag of genres, leaning toward horror, thriller, and absurd dark comedy.

hero.alt: An orange one-eyed figure above glowing blue Midnight Programming lettering against a dark, star-filled background.

credits.name: Otha Derek Hernandez Peña and Leah Claire Borrie
